_meta.method: SRTR's official 5-tier ratings (1-5, 5 best): 1-year graft survival, deceased-donor transplant rate ('faster'), and waitlist survival — adult and pediatric. External published ratings, not TransPlan-derived. Pediatric tiers are the first per-center pediatric source (#335 phase 2).
_meta.scale_note: 1 = worse than expected ... 5 = better than expected, per SRTR's Bayesian tier assignment
